label: Lucius - GoDaddy Restore (from file)
info:
Manual trigger ONLY, same 'wipe/migrate scenario, not routine' convention as godaddy_restore_flow.json and wherewhen_data_restore_flow.json. Sibling to godaddy_restore_flow.json (which restores from HA's own local SQLite mirror) — this one instead restores from an arbitrary external WardStock-export-shaped JSON file, for exactly the situation Ward hit Aug 2026: a mysqldump/phpMyAdmin SQL backup existed but HA's own SQLite mirror didn't have anything backed up yet (godaddy_backup_flow.json never having run against that data), so there was no flow that could import that backup at all.

Expects /share/lucius_restore_import.json to already exist on the HA box, in the exact shape api/pull_manual_data.php / export.php already produce: {"records": [...]}, each record tagged with record_type (incident / daily_log / therapy_session / medication / medication_dosage_history). A raw .sql dump is NOT a supported input directly — no SQL parser lives in Node-RED here, on purpose (this project's own convention: don't build a general-purpose thing when a narrow one solves the actual problem). Converting a mysqldump into this shape is a one-off task performed once, outside Node-RED (Claude did this for the Aug 2026 restore — see ForWard/wardstock_restore_from_sql_backup.json and its own generation notes); this flow is the reusable, permanent half — it will import ANY file in the correct shape, not just that one conversion.

Copy the converted JSON to /share/lucius_restore_import.json (via Studio Code Server or the Samba/SFTP share, same as any other /share file this project already uses) before running.

POSTs straight through to the same api/bulk_restore.php as godaddy_restore_flow.json — same import_records() merge-safe logic, same 'nothing was saved on any failure partway through' transaction guarantee. Does NOT write to HA's local godaddy_backup SQLite table itself — after a successful run, GoDaddy has the data; run godaddy_backup_flow.json afterward (or wait for its 3am schedule) to bring HA's own local mirror back in sync with what's now on GoDaddy, same as any other time GoDaddy's data changes.

No companion test flow — reuses api/bulk_restore.php and the merge-safe logic already exercised by godaddy_backup_test.json's fixture-round-trip checks and (once run for real) godaddy_restore_flow.json itself; the only genuinely new logic here is the file-read + shape-validation step, small enough that this flow's own tab info and debug output serve the same purpose a dedicated test flow would.

UNTESTED — same caveat as every new flow in this project. Read the whole tab info before running against a real GoDaddy database.
